cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：里面的
cards.example_en: The inner pocket of my coat held the bus ticket.
cards.example_zh: 我外套里面的口袋装着公交票。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：因此；相应地
cards.example_en: He was told to wait, and he did accordingly.
cards.example_zh: 有人让他等，他就照做了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：大胆地
cards.example_en: She boldly volunteered to speak first.
cards.example_zh: 她大胆地主动要求第一个发言。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：显著地
cards.example_en: Her English has improved significantly this term.
cards.example_zh: 这学期她的英语进步很大。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：慢慢地
cards.example_en: The bus moved slowly through the snow.
cards.example_zh: 公交车在雪里开得很慢。

cards.example_en: They live in a small apartment in the city centre.
cards.example_zh: 他们住在市中心的一间小公寓里。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：地下室
cards.example_en: The boxes are in the basement.
The school will implement new lunch rules next month.
cards.example_zh: 学校下个月将实施新的午餐规定。

cards.example_en: Poor management caused long queues at the ticket window.
cards.example_zh: 管理不善，售票窗口排起了长队。

cards.example_en: Please pay attention to the teacher.
A wedding is a special occasion.
cards.example_zh: 婚礼是一个特殊的场合。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：健美操
cards.example_en: Morning aerobics left my legs shaking before school.
cards.example_zh: 早上的健美操让我上学前腿一直在抖。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：非洲人
cards.example_en: An African joined our basketball team last September.
cards.example_zh: 去年九月，一位非洲人加入了我们的篮球队。
